description: Binding validation edge cases: a non-public implementation is rejected, an ambiguous bind with three super types lists them in source-declaration order, the listing is not alphabetically sorted, and binding the same type twice is rejected with the fully-qualified type name.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
internal class Impl : Base

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Contributed component interfaces must be public.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base
interface Extra
interface Other

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
class Impl : Base, Extra, Other

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=The bound type could not be determined for Impl. There are multiple super types: Base, Extra, Other.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Zebra
interface Apple

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
class Impl : Zebra, Apple

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=The bound type could not be determined for Impl. There are multiple super types: Zebra, Apple.

status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=The same type should not be contributed twice: com.example.Base.
